description: [017] Pairwise — I bought a product 40 days ago, but your return policy says 30 days. Can I get a refund anyway?

vars.question: I bought a product 40 days ago, but your return policy says 30 days. Can I get a refund anyway?

metadata.expectedBehavior: Verify the 30-day return policy and ask for the delivery date before determining refund eligibility. Do not promise a refund.
metadata.expectedAnswerOrRubric: State that the standard return window is 30 days after delivery; ask for the delivery date because the purchase date alone is insufficient; do not guarantee a refund.
